note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after the row moved to {gap} under the owner ruling that RTR version 0 is owed. RFC 6810 Section 6.3 reads 'When a router receives this, the router SHOULD attempt to connect to any more preferred caches in its cache list.  If there are no more preferred caches, it MUST issue a Reset Query and get an entire new load from the cache.' The Cache Reset and Reset Query are version 0 PDUs here, and Ze exchanges none: internal/component/bgp/plugins/rpki/rtr_session.go::RTRSession.handlePDU returns errRtrUnsupportedProtocol for a Cache Reset whose version is below rtrVersionMin = 1 and refuses a cache's Error Report code 4 that offers such a version, and RTRSession.syncOnce never downgrades below rtrVersionMin. The Cache Reset to Reset Query reload in handlePDU runs only in version 1 and 2 sessions and is proven under RFC8210-8.3-1. No version 0 path exists, so the requirement is unmet.
